title: Abyssals v0.90.47 — Tide and Orchard
notes: Two approved families: Rillkit → Undertide → Mournami and Mewisp → Purrchard, with smooth transparent artwork, evolution, breeding, shinies and Field Journal habitats. Every third special HP hit triggers Stillwater’s three 50-power Water slashes. Berry Pantry regrows eaten berries every turn at 25%, or 75% in Grassy Terrain. 43 branded techniques have independent vector battle effects; existing branded protection, screens and weather are reused. Draining Roots, effigy-only Breeze Relay, berry handling, terrain, special retaliation and disruption are implemented and tested. Species inhabit clear sluicewater, reed banks, a flooded cloister, subtropical canopy and intact fruit groves. Save format, story progress and original Android signing identity are preserved.
